'''R-9XR''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] forces during the [[Korriban Incursion]], when the Republic invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="TOR" /> in [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> R-9XR was tasked with guarding the force field erected in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] next to the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall]], but was destroyed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces in their push to retake the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
R-9XR appears as the second boss in the Imperial version of the Tactical Flashpoint "Korriban Incursion," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.7: Invasion. For Republic players, R-9XR is replaced by [[I5-T1]], and the two are virtually identical in terms of their game mechanics.<ref name="TOR" />
